For trademark classes 9/42, my inference is that the compound has a credible inherently distinctive position for downloadable CMS software and hosted services under the [USPTO framework](https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/basics/strong-trademarks). Search FRITWORK, FRETWORK, FRITTWORK, and relevant FRITZ variants against related goods/services: [sound and appearance matter](https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/search/federal-trademark-searching), and free namespaces do not establish clearance.
